messages.content: Hey, it's your weekly check-in from Northline Care. Hope the week's been decent out your way. Do you have a blood pressure reading to share when you get a moment?
Thanks — got 138/84 logged for you. Any issues with your medications this week, or everything running smooth?
All good on that front. Starting to get cold up here already
Ha, North Dakota doesn't waste any time. Glad the meds are on track. I'll schedule your next check-in for the same time next week — take care of yourself until then.

theme: routine weekly check-in, reading logged, nothing else
